# pump-fun-workers

> A Cloudflare Worker that implements the MCP Streamable HTTP transport for AI agents to interact with pump.fun on Solana.

pump-fun-workers is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [Deploy](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/README.md#deploy)
- [Connect from SperaxOS](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/README.md#connect-from-speraxos)
- [Development](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/README.md#development)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/README.md#architecture)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-workers/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
